Für diese Version wurden keine Versionshinweise hinterlegt.

New in 2.0.0:
• On-device barcode scanning with ZXing instead of ML Kit.
• Product names and categories follow the app language.
• Refreshed scanner, history, settings and onboarding with Nunito typography.
• Clearer product details, nutrition values and manual entry forms.
• Restyled dialogs and the What’s new screen.
• New option to send nutrition values to GymMane Quick add (requires a compatible GymMane version).
• Nunito font credit moved to the README.
Thanks to @InlitX for PRs #1–#9!
